extension.description: Standalone Chaturbate Kodi addon with priority-based TV mode, local favorites, and HLS playback through a localhost rewriting proxy.
extension.news: 0.6.5 - Online favorites now render with thumbnails, viewer count, and plot info on the left (matching the browse views) - the bulk room-list fetch already had the live-model data, we just weren't propagating it to the ListItem. Offline favorites stay as bare entries by design (we deliberately don't poll 1000+ slugs to get stale metadata; offline rooms have no live data to show anyway). Plus: docs sweep - LESSONS-LEARNED gets six new entries (15 API limit drift, 16 top-level menu network ban, 17 paginated rendering, 18 busy-dialog dismiss, 19 hot-path log noise, 20 long-running plugin invocation spinner). README + PLANNING current-state blocks updated. 0.6.4 - URGENT API contract fix: chaturbate's room-list API now caps limit at 100 (was 500); every bulk fetch was getting HTTP 400 'Bad Request' and Online Favorites showed empty even with live models in the user's list. Lowered _BULK_PAGE_LIMIT to 100, raised _BULK_MAX_PAGES to 50 to keep coverage at ~5000 rooms. Pinned with regression test. Plus: dismiss any lingering Kodi busy dialog at TV mode + favs entry points ('s pattern - prevents the "stuck spinner over playing video" UX after a previous slow invocation). 0.6.3 - URGENT favorites fix: 1224-fav library locked up the UI on . Top-level Favorites menu no longer triggers a network call (just shows Online/Offline drill-downs); bulk room-list fetch is deferred to category open. Online/Offline views paginate at 50 entries per page so the directory render doesn't choke on 1000+ rows. Bulk-fetch now has a politeness pacer between page calls AND a 30-min on-disk cache so re-entering Favorites after a Kodi restart is instant. Per-segment / per-chunklist hls_proxy "OK" log lines dropped (1+/sec was flooding the feature log during steady-state playback); errors and reconnects still log. 0.6.2 - QA HIGH bundle: HLS proxy now rewrites EXT-X-RENDITION-REPORT URI in chunklist bodies (LL-HLS quality-switch fetches were going direct to chaturbate edges and getting 403'd). chaturbatetv_active literal centralized in tv_state.ACTIVE_KEY (was duplicated across tv_loop, addon_actions). TV playlist URLs now derive slug from TVEntry.url instead of using the display name (broke playback for any user-customized name; ``Alice the Cam Star`` was being passed where ``alice`` belonged). Migration tool no longer crashes when source favorites.db lacks the expected schema (table missing, wrong columns, etc). 0.6.1 - QA fix bundle: Search row routes to mode=search_prompt (was a dead route to the renderer that closes on empty query). TV-mode offline auto-skip lands (Lesson v6.1) - when the active TV playlist hits an offline slug, fire Action(Next) so the player advances instead of sitting on a black screen. Settings.xml entries finally read in production: poll_minutes (TV loop interval), isa_proxy_port (fixed-port option for locked-down LANs), screensaver_color (cyan / green / hotpink). New addon_settings module centralizes the read+clamp+default behavior. 0.6.0 - Phase 5: TV mode lands. _TVPlayer subclass with state-reset between iterations (Lesson 10), file-switch takeover detection (Lesson 11), idle-time disambiguator at the stop site (Lesson 17), random-tier pick (Lesson 14). Idle screensaver via xbmcgui.Window (NOT WindowDialog - Lesson 20) with HALO cyan bouncing label, periodic re-walk every 60s. tv_play / tv_stop / tv_list / tv_add / tv_remove / tv_edit verbs all wired through tv_store. Browse + favs rows now show a state-aware right-click menu (Add to TV vs In TV / Edit / Remove; Add to Favorites vs Remove from Favorites). Verbose logging gated on enh_debug across the new modules. 0.5.0 - Phase 4c: HLS proxy hardened with the eleven PR #1818 lessons. Chunklists and segments now route through 127.0.0.1 so ISA always uses our headers (was 403ing direct CDN hits). Gzip-aware fetcher, three-tier segment fallback, cached playlists during reconnect, lock-protected reconnect guard, watchdog after a successful refresh, terminal-flag fast-path (ENDLIST chunklists / 410 segments) so ISA tears down cleanly. Verbose logging gated on enh_debug across cb_client, cb_resolve, cb_listing, browse_views, favs_views, router, tv_state, hls_proxy. Bonus: favs menu now bulk-fetches the live room-list once instead of polling every favorite (~5s vs 4 minutes for 1224 favs, Lesson 11). 0.4.3 - Fix Cannot download manifest: cb_resolve switched to AJAX endpoint (reliable JSON) instead of the fragile HTML dossier scrape. Strip hashtag duplicates from the subject line (tag-line at the bottom already shows them in green). Light gated logging on the playvid path (logger._log -> chaturbatetv_feature.log when enh_debug=true). 0.4.2 - Phase 4b: playvid resolver + ISA props (Matrix+ inputstream key, manifest_type=hls, stream/manifest headers urlencoded, MIME hint, contentLookup=False); addon_actions.playvid wired through setResolvedUrl with offline notification. Browse + favs views now declare content-type=videos so InfoWall / MediaList view modes are available (thumbnail on the right, plot on the left). 0.4.1 - QA-driven polish: model thumbnails (real img URL not hardcoded), hover plot info (Age / Location / Watching / Followers / Tags), favs labels render (8-char hex), favs Online/Offline drill-down works (was a router gap). 0.4.0 - Phase 4a: localhost HLS rewriting proxy (MVP). Master playlist absolutize+rewrite, iPad UA + Referer header injection, dynamic 127.0.0.1 port. Stream playback hookup lands in 0.4.1. 0.3.1 - Fix [COLOR] tags: Kodi requires 8-char AARRGGBB hex; bare 6-char rendered Female/Male/Couple/Trans labels and model names blank. 0.3.0 - Switch browse to Chaturbates JSON API (room-list endpoint). Drops HTML scraping entirely. 0.2.1 - Polish: full-bleed fanart, provider-name fix. 0.2.0 - Phase 2: browse menus (Top, New, Female, Male, Couple, Trans, Search), local favorites, migration tool.
